item.text: {"rule":"The first tap appears to leave either the tapped pair or the untapped pair, and the second tap then either keeps or discards the tapped card. Which alternative occurs varies across rounds; the observations are insufficient to infer more than an apparently variable (possibly random) choice at each step."}
